feelings, and behaviors. Clothing is not just about covering our bodies; it plays a significant role in
shaping our self-perception and interactions with others.

mood, and identity. Whether we opt for bold, colorful outfits or prefer more understated styles, our dress

题目与逐题解析
21.What was the author commissioned to do about English public libraries?
[ A ]Document their valuable traditions.
[ B ]Make a plan for their expansions.
[ C ]Obtain reader opinions on them.
[ D ]Look into their current situation.
作者受委托就英国公共图书馆做什么工作?
A) 记录它们的宝贵传统。 B) 为它们的扩建制定计划。 C) 获取读者对它们的意见。
D) 调查它们的现状。
【答案】D （细节题）

【判型】What was the author commissioned to do 问的是一个具体动作的内容，不是推断、不
是态度，属典型细节题。
【拆句】What was the author commissioned to do about English public libraries? 是一个被动
语态疑问句。主干 the author was commissioned to do what, about English public
libraries 是范围状语。结构平铺直叙，无陷阱。
【定位】The reality is startlingly different, as I discovered when the culture department commissioned
me to conduct an independent review of English public libraries, published yesterday.
现实却截然不同——这是我在文化部委托我对英国公共图书馆进行独立审查（昨日发布）时
发现的。
【选项】A) 偷换概念
选项把 valuable traditions 塞给作者作为审查目标，但作者要审查的是"现状"，第 1 段
的 dusty, old-fashioned 也只是大众成见，并非"宝贵传统"。
B) 过度推断
原文只委托作者去 review，并未让他"为扩张做计划"；末段 national branding
campaign 等也是建议宣传而非"扩张"，时间也不在委托当时。
C) 无中生有
作者是受文化部委托做整体审查，并非"收集读者意见"——原文未提任何 reader
survey/opinion collection，是无中生有。
D) ✓ 正确
conduct an independent review of English public libraries ↔
Look into their current situation

第1段，第3句
What 引导的主语从句是四六级和考研阅读中的高频句式，尤其是 What 在从句中充当主语成分这
一用法，在学术文章和新闻报道中非常常见。本句的结构（What 从句 + 主句谓语 + 分词短语作状
语）代表了一种典型的复杂句模式，掌握后可以迁移到大量类似句子的理解中。唯一不够极致典型
的是 blossom into 这一搭配不如 become、turn into 等常见。
Chicago's summer festivals are about more than just entertainment; they are
economic engines that directly benefit the neighborhoods they're in and the city of
Chicago as a whole.
第3段，第1句
分号连接并列主句、定语从句修饰表语、关系代词省略等结构都是四六级和考研真题中的常见句
式。学生掌握本句后可将方法迁移到大量类似句子，具有较高的典型性和复用价值。
Despite the turnout, gate donations reached their lowest point in our history.
第5段，第3句
主句 + 让步状语的结构在四六级和考研阅读中较为常见，"Despite" 引导让步也是典型考点。但本
句结构相对简单，未涉及从句或复杂修饰，作为句式代表性中等偏上。
We are eliminating a stage, booking fewer performers and making additional cuts
to reduce our costs, all while striving to keep the festival as vibrant as ever, as
supportive of local artists and businesses, and as true to Wicker Park's unique
spirit and reputation as festgoers have come to expect.
第5段，第5句
